description: Phase 5: SolutionPlan -> candidate_solutions translation rules. SolutionPlan is the CANONICAL source of candidate solutions (it replaces the phantom `candidate_solutions` input that had no producer). All mapping is externalized here; the translator never invents product facts.
no_action_objective_markers: （当前无待解决的保障缺口，暂无解决策略）

unverifiable_constraint_policy.description: Unverifiable is NOT a violation and NOT a pass. A strategy cannot be checked against product-level constraints without product data, so the constraint is surfaced as an uncertainty and forces human review.

detail_by_type.budget: candidate premium unknown (strategy layer carries no product quote); budget constraint not verifiable
detail_by_type.term: candidate term unknown (strategy layer carries no product term); term constraint not verifiable
detail_by_type.liquidity: candidate liquidity impact unknown (strategy layer carries no product data); liquidity constraint not verifiable

notes: premium / term / insurer / product_name are deliberately NOT derived from the strategy. Inventing them would be fabricating product facts.
coverage_structure comes from solution_type only. Partial coverage is expressed by the gap, not by downgrading the strategy's coverage claim.
